title: Uni-Stream: A Unified Streaming Speech Language Model for Speech Synthesis and Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.32187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified streaming speech language models aim to support speech recognition and synthesis within a single model, enabling real-time human-computer interaction. However, jointly supporting these two directions of speech-text conversion while preserving task-specific performance remains challenging. We propose Uni-Stream, a unified streaming speech language model built on compact pretrained speech models. Uni-Stream processes interleaved text and speech in a streaming format and achieves performance comparable to task-specific models through two-stage training. We also develop a data annotation pipeline for streaming training and will publicly release the generated transcriptions and word-level timestamps. translated_title: Uni-Stream：一个用于语音合成与识别的统一流式语音语言模型
translated_abstract: 统一流式语音语言模型旨在在单一模型中同时支持语音识别与语音合成，从而实现实时人机交互。然而，在同时支持语音-文本转换这两个方向的同时保持各任务的具体性能仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了Uni-Stream，一个基于紧凑型预训练语音模型构建的统一流式语音语言模型。Uni-Stream以流式格式处理交错的文本与语音，并通过两阶段训练实现了与任务专用模型相当的性能。我们还开发了一个用于流式训练的数据标注流水线，并将公开发布所生成的转录文本和词级时间戳。我们进一步考察了Uni-Stream在跨任务、跨模态下的表示，发现即使在同一统一模型架构中训练，语音和文本仍处于不同的潜在特征空间中，而每个模态内部的表示则……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Uni-Stream——一个基于紧凑型预训练语音模型、以流式方式处理交错文本与语音的统一语音语言模型，通过两阶段训练在单一模型中同时实现媲美任务专用模型的语音识别与语音合成性能。
en_tdlr: Uni-Stream is a unified streaming speech language model built on compact pretrained speech models that processes interleaved text and speech in a streaming format, achieving task-specific-model-comparable performance for both speech recognition and synthesis within a single model.
